changes: Fix head_joint at zero yaw, retaining head link geometry, collisions, mass and inertia.
Remove head_joint from the exported joint order and omit the head IK target.
Make mesh and robot.yaml paths relative to this self-contained edition directory.

Replace both rubber-hand visual meshes and their three collision primitives per side with matching 54 mm diameter spheres at the existing hand frames; retain wrist housing collisions and inertial definitions.
Group each foot's 24 collision primitives under a fixed foot link coincident with its ankle-roll frame; retain ankle articulation, visuals and inertia, and use the foot links for contact references.
Add two 15 mm diameter capsule return arms perpendicular to the rear neck-handle crossbar, represented by cylinders and spheres.

Retain all 24 sole primitives per foot and add a three-primitive side-perimeter layer (toe cylinder, heel cylinder and connecting box), spanning local z=-0.035 to -0.007 m; no separate top-surface collider.
Align the handle return capsules with the visual arms: shift each 6 mm laterally outward and 5 mm toward the torso; preserve capsule dimensions and the crossbar.
Shorten both neck-handle return capsule centerline segments from 40 to 35 mm at the curved-bar end, retaining the torso-end sphere centers and 7.5 mm radius.
calibration: Not bundled; calibrate separately for each motion reference.
